compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, sub-agent worktrees branch from session HEAD (not main HEAD) so per-story isolation works correctly
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Resolve bug 4724-41a7 — when the orchestrator is in a session worktree and dispatches a sub-agent with worktree.isolation_enabled=true, Claude Code currently creates the sub-agent's worktree from main repo HEAD instead of session HEAD; this story makes the base resolve to session HEAD.
**Why**: Foundation for all story-branch work. Without this fix, every story merge produces a synthetic diff covering all session-branch work since main, exceeding region-split threshold on every story.

**Scope**:
- IN: Identify the dispatch path that determines sub-agent worktree base
- IN: Ensure resolved base is session HEAD when orchestrator CWD is a worktree session
- IN: Regression test: dispatched sub-agent's worktree base SHA equals session HEAD SHA when orchestrator is in worktree session
- OUT: Other isolation-related bugs (file separately)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, dispatching a sub-agent from a session worktree with worktree.isolation_enabled=true produces a sub-agent worktree whose base SHA equals the session HEAD SHA, not the main HEAD SHA
  ← Satisfies: "SC7: Bug 4724-41a7 fix as Phase 1 prerequisite (applies to all modes — foundational)"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Worktree-creation contract change affects every sub-agent dispatch path in the codebase. Enumerate consumers (sprint Phase E, fix-bug worktree creation, debug-everything parallel batches, harvest-worktree, recipe-executor, manual orchestrator dispatch). For each, verify the new contract produces correct behavior or document the path as exempt with rationale.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
